# ASS00647

ASS00647 is a specific laboratory code used within the Danish healthcare system to register the measurement of thyrotropin, commonly known as [[thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh|thyreoideastimulerende hormon (TSH)]] [^src1]. 

In the context of national clinical quality standards, this code plays a precise administrative and clinical role in the "Atrieflimren i Danmark" (Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark) program managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP). Specifically, ASS00647 is recognized as one of the valid laboratory codes that count as a performed TSH measurement for "Indicator 3" [^src1]. When calculating the metrics for this quality indicator—which tracks whether atrial fibrillation patients receive proper diagnostic workups including thyroid function tests—the presence of the ASS00647 code in a patient's health record satisfies the TSH measurement requirement [^src1]. It is officially listed alongside several other acceptable codes, such as NPU27547, NPU04199, and DNK35895, ensuring that different regional hospital systems and laboratory information systems can accurately and uniformly report compliance with evidence-based clinical standards [^src1].
